messages:
maya: Hey team — quick cross-check before sprint close. We're planning to include two new open models in the catalog: horizon-6b-open and fern-13b-ql. I need a one-line status for each on: licensing sign-off, perf profile ready, infra/deploy owner. Calling out any blockers.

sam: horizon-6b-open: eng-ml owner assigned (sam). Perf benching in progress, basic profile exists but needs long-sequence tails. Licensing: waiting on anya to confirm redistribution terms. Infra: tara for dedicated capacity/quant policy.

anya-legal: FYI I flagged horizon's license for a CLA clause around dataset attribution. Should be minor — I can clear with a short approval email today if maintainers confirm attribution text. fern-13b-ql has an ambiguous commercial clause, need 24h to confirm.

kevin-bench: perf quick update: horizon-6b-open median latency (p50) at sequence=512 is 78ms on our optimized runtime (A100-like). Throughput looks fine. fern-13b-ql currently spikes at token 1024 due to rotary + kv cache changes, I'm experimenting with chunked attention patch.

kevin-bench: pushed a draft perf profile to the repo: `models/profiles/fern-13b-ql.yaml` — includes fallback to quant-4 for heavy tails. Can run a replay if you want numbers on the customer prompt set.

maya: @kevin-bench please run the replay on the realtime prompt set used by catalog smoke tests, that'll help decide default quant+cache settings.

sam: noted. I'll also open a small PR to add both models to the model-index with owners/metadata. pinging for CR: @tara-platform for deploy config, @maya for metadata fields.

tara-platform: infra check: dedicated pool has headroom for horizon if we reserve 2x slots for canary. fern needs a compatibility test for KV cache migration on the runtime — I'll schedule a canary slot tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Also need the rollout policy: do we want canary -> gradual 10% -> 50% -> 100%?

maya: yes, standard rollout is fine. For fern let's do canary -> 10% -> 50% -> metrics gate. Who owns the metrics gate? @kevin-bench?

kevin-bench: I can own the metrics gate. I'll add the latency and token-loss regression checks. If we see >5% token-level divergence vs baseline, abort.

anya-legal: on horizon attribution text — maintainers replied and accepted the standard snippet. I'm clearing horizon now. fern still needs the 24h review; should be done by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: CI: models-index PR #412 failed schema linter in `models/index.json` for missing `risk_profile` field. See: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/412

sam: thanks bot. I'll fix the schema and repush in a few mins.

sam: PR updated and pushed. PTAL @tara-platform for deploy annotations.

tara-platform: reviewed the deploy annotations, small nit on `max_inflight` default. Recommend set to 32 for horizon canary. I've scheduled the canary window and added the canary-runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/model-canary.md

maya: perfect. Timeline check: horizon licensing cleared now, perf nominal, infra canary ready -> we can schedule horizon canary for tomorrow 09:30 PT. fern waits for legal + kevin perf patch; target canary Friday if all green.

kevin-bench: will run replay tonight and post numbers in this thread. If the chunked attention patch fixes token spikes, we can move fern earlier.

maya: final asks: (1) @anya-legal confirm fern status by EOD tomorrow, (2) @kevin-bench drop replay results here, (3) @sam link the PR when it's green, (4) @tara-platform confirm canary slots. Thanks all.

sam: will post PR link when green.

kevin-bench: replay results (night run): fern-13b-ql after patch median p50=210ms @seq512, token-spike reduced 40%. attaching quick diff in case people want it:
```
- attention.window = default
+ attention.window = chunked(64)
```

maya: awesome, that looks promising. :thumbsup:

anya-legal: fern cleared — commercial clause interpreted as non-restrictive after liaison response. I'll send the formal clearance email and add the license note to the model metadata.

tara-platform: canary slots confirmed: horizon tomorrow 09:30 PT, fern Friday 10:00 PT. I've also added capacity reservations and the rollout policy in the deploy plan.

maya: thanks team — I'll update the catalog launch checklist and close the open items. If anything changes, reply here.
